COMPANY NAME: Oracle
INDUSTRY: Enterprise Software, Cloud Computing, and Database Management
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: Oracle provides a comprehensive suite of cloud infrastructure, platform, and software services, including the world's first autonomous database, AI-powered cloud applications, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) solutions.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Large enterprises, government agencies, and organizations of all sizes across various industries, including healthcare, finance, and technology.
PRICING MODEL: Enterprise / Subscription / Usage-based (Cloud)
KEY FEATURES:
- World’s first autonomous database
- Broadest and deepest suite of AI-powered cloud applications
- Extensive portfolio of enterprise applications (ERP, HCM, SCM)
- Large-scale EHR implementation serving millions of beneficiaries
- Robust developer and customer community support
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS: Decades of innovation history, massive scale with $57B revenue, extensive R&D investment, and a proven track record of building entire industries through data and AI solutions.
TONE & POSITIONING: Enterprise / Premium / Industry Leader
